## ⚔️ Thorne Timer {TAG}

{BANNER}
**Your EverQuest companion — real-time log parsing, overlay timers, and voice alerts crafted for the way you play.**

Thorne Timer watches your log files in real-time and turns game events into overlay timers, voice alerts, and notifications — giving you the situational awareness that UI files alone can't provide. Whether you're raiding, soloing, or multi-boxing, it keeps the information you need visible and on screen.

Built and tested with the [Project Quarm](https://www.projectquarm.com/) and [TAKP](https://www.takproject.net/) communities, but works with **any EverQuest server** (or any application) that writes text-based log files.

---

### 🆕 What's New in {TAG}

{WHATSNEW}

---

### ✨ Key Features

- **🎯 Timer Overlays (Mini Views)** — Compact, always-on-top windows that float over your game. User-editable Styles and Views drive routing, color, and warning behavior.
- **⏱️ Real-Time Log Parsing** — Start/end keyword matching, case-sensitive mode, endless (auto-restart) timers, and timer dependencies.
- **🔊 Voice & Sound Alerts** — Text-to-speech and WAV playback with per-timer audio, adjustable volume and speech rate. 200+ built-in sounds organized by category.
- **📊 Timer Styles & Scopes** — Route timers to specific overlay windows by style. Scope timers to World, Character, or Character+ for multi-character setups.
- **🗂️ Tome System** — Portable `.tdb` database stores all timers, characters, categories, and settings. Multiple tomes, recent-file switching, and automatic migration from older versions.
- **👥 Multi-Character Support** — Per-character log files, auto-switching from log detection, camp-out auto-pause, independent mini view positions, and class-based timer filtering.
- **🖥️ Compact & Full Views** — Toggle between a compact read-only grid and a full editing view. Column widths, sort state, and window position are all persisted.
- **📁 Configurable Retention** — `ThorneTimer.ini` controls log file and database backup retention with a tiered pruning algorithm.

---

### 📦 Installation
1. Download **`ThorneTimer-{TAG}.zip`** below
2. Extract to a folder of your choice
3. Run **`ThorneTimer.exe`**
4. Point it at your EQ log file and you're ready to go

> 🔄 **Upgrading?** Just extract over your existing folder. Your tome (`.tdb` database) will be migrated automatically — all your timers, characters, and settings are preserved.

### 🖥️ Requirements
- Windows with .NET Framework 4.8 (included in Windows 10 1903+)
- EverQuest with logging enabled (`/log on`)
